document_id: AEMET 2024 - ESTUDIO SOBRE LA SITUACIÓN DE LLUVIAS INTENSAS

locations.source_text: Between October 28 and November 4, 2024, a long episode of intense rains, locally torrential and persistent, occurred in our country, which affected to a greater extent the provinces of the Mediterranean, adjacent provinces of the communities of Castilla-La Mancha and Aragon, as well as part of the south-western quadrant.
